bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags may measure up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches; nonclear purses may be up to 10 × 6 × 2 inches, and one-gallon clear bags are allowed. Medical and diaper bags receive inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: McCormick Place Lot A at 2301 South Prairie Avenue is the closest and lists $27 for up to 16 hours or $40 for 16–24 hours. Lots B and C are farther away with different rates; check posted prices before travel.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The arena’s A–Z and directions pages do not publish a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off curb.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands operate on all concourses and list Pepsi drinks, hot dogs, hamburgers, chicken tenders and plant-based tenders among their offerings.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking is available in McCormick Place Lot A on a first-come basis. Request sign-language interpretation at least 10 working days before the event.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests cannot re-enter after leaving the building during an event.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The arena box office is at 200 East Cermak Road and opens three hours before each event, closing one hour after it starts. Event-day ticket delivery and pickup instructions depend on the seller.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The arena uses metal detectors at entry. The A–Z guide lists the box office on the south side between Prairie and Indiana, but does not set a universal concert door-opening time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
